reviews.text:
We've been taking our dog Balú to this center for a year now, both for boarding and daycare, and we couldn't be happier.

The facilities are fantastic, and above all, you can really see the love and care the dogs receive. Balú goes absolutely crazy with excitement to go inside every time we arrive! For us, that's the best sign that he's happy and well cared for.

Plus, the whole team is lovely and always treats him with so much love. Dealing with our Balú, who's a real whirlwind, requires a good dose of patience 😂

Without a doubt, we recommend it 100% and hope to continue taking him for many more years. Thank you for taking such good care of him! ❤️
Everything was perfect. We left our dog with them for a week and they were very nice and professional.

I took my dog ​​there a couple of months ago. Unfortunately, they keep all the dogs together without understanding that each one has its own personality. We picked her up with several bites. After a significant vet bill, luckily she has recovered well. We won't be going back.

I took my cat to Gufy and I'm delighted with the experience. From the very first moment, they instilled a great deal of confidence in me, and you can see the care they give to the animals.

I loved the exclusive cat area: it's beautiful, meticulously maintained, very well-equipped, and designed for their comfort and tranquility. You can tell they've paid attention to every detail.

The entire team was lovely, attentive, and professional, and I felt very reassured knowing my cat was in good hands. I'm leaving very grateful for the service and will definitely be back.

Thank you so much for the 5 stars! ❤️

We love having Rocky here; he's a regular at Gufy! 🥰 It's always a joy to see him again and have him with us for a few days.

Thank you for continuing to trust us and for letting us take care of him. We're so lucky to have clients like you! 🐾💙

We love having Rocky here!

Sylph, my kitten, spent two weeks at the boarding facility this summer and came back perfectly happy, relaxed, and clearly very well cared for.

Thanks to Silvia and the team of caregivers—the three "S's"—your attention, affection, and patience are evident in how he returned.
For us, this boarding facility has become our go-to place. Thank you for treating Sylph like he was your own.

Thank you so much for those 5 stars, Jimena! ⭐️❤️

We're so happy you chose Gufy for your pet's boarding and training. We hope to see you again very soon! 🐶🐾

Hello M B. We're sorry to see your 1-star rating. We'd like to know what happened and how we can improve your experience with Gufy.

If you'd like, you can contact us and we'd be happy to hear from you. Thank you.

Bad experience. They arrived malnourished. I was told they'd be let out for a little while each day, but they've been locked in a cage day and night, all three of them. They arrived scared and are still afraid, and to top it all off, they kept the 4kg bag of food. They only got one small food bowl and water bowl for all three of them. I give each of my dogs one at home. No way I'm leaving them there again.

Thank you so much for your 5-star rating! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ We're delighted to hear that your experience at our dog center was so positive. We work with dedication and care every day to provide the best care and well-being for each dog. It was a pleasure serving you, and we hope to see you again very soon. Thank you for trusting us!

Thank you so much for your fantastic review! We're so happy to know you were satisfied with our work and the service you received. Comments like yours motivate us to keep giving our best every day. We hope to welcome you and your four-legged friend back very soon. Warm regards and thanks for trusting our team!
Dog and cat boarding facility with a large lawn for dogs to run free. The facilities are indoors and climate-controlled.

Absolutely recommended!
I travel a lot for work and leave my two children there, and they also attend daycare for some days, and the service and facilities are exceptional!
I left my dog ​​Lucky there this weekend and they were fantastic. He was super comfortable and very well cared for, just like at home. I'll definitely be back!
A trustworthy dog ​​center

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
It makes us so happy to know that Freya had such a positive experience with us. It's a pleasure to care for her and share such special moments. 💚🐾

We're always waiting for you with open arms and lots of cuddles for Freya! 🐶✨
Thank you, it was a pleasure.

Django has been coming to my go-to kennel for over five years now. I'm so happy with how all the staff treat me; they're always attentive and respectful of each dog's personality. Django is so happy when he arrives and when I pick him up. The grounds are quite spacious and the facilities are perfect for the animals.

We've been taking our dog Leia to Gufy for three months now. Gufy is practically her second home. We take her every other day, and seeing her happily wag her tail as she enters is a testament to the excellent care she receives there. We've also left her for two days at a time, and it was wonderful. The facilities at Los Chelines are fully indoors and climate-controlled. There are several yards for her to play with other dogs, as well as a large green area where they can also go out to play. The caregivers are very attentive and professional. Thank you for all the helpful information and comments regarding Leia's care.
Staff very good and our dogs are very happy here. Staff kindly showed us a video of the dogs at play to reassure us. A regular kennels for us.

It's been a little over two years since our Dante came to live with Gufy, and I can assure you it wasn't easy for us to decide where to leave our beloved little guy, but it was the best decision we could have made. They were very patient with him during his initial adjustment period, which gave us a lot of peace of mind. He's getting better every day and comes home happy, of course ;-), but he's the same old Dante... affectionate and playful, which says a lot about how he's been during his time with the kids at Gufy.
Oh, they're so cute! They're a bit far away, but my dog ​​loves them.
Our dog Mancha gets very excited when we approach Gufy. It's a sign she's having a great time. Excellent facilities and even better staff. Thank you so much!

Since Pichi was a puppy, he's stayed at Gufy whenever I can't take him with me. Whenever I go to pick him up, whether it's for a weekend stay or a two-week period, he comes, greets me, and goes off with his caregivers. He adores them... there's no greater sign that it's the right place. I must say he's not an easy dog ​​because he has multiple allergies and takes medication, and he always, always gets all his doses. We've never had a problem. They're adaptable, keep you informed, send you videos... always with love. You certainly won't see my little guy at any other kennel.

This is the first time my dog ​​has come back from a place in bad shape (and he's quite used to being in kennels). They hardly ever let them outside (their excuse was that it was raining, and my dog ​​doesn't care about the rain). I asked for videos, and they sent one, and I was grateful (their excuse was again that because it was raining, they couldn't film him because he didn't want to go out). My dog ​​is a Border Collie, and he doesn't care at all if it rains, snows, or thunders; he loves being outside. Well, according to them, they couldn't film him because it was raining, and he didn't want to leave the kennel... anyway. They inspire ZERO confidence, and I'm not saying they don't take care of them, but they don't inspire peace of mind by not telling you how your dog is doing or sending you any updates. And then they're practically in their cages all the time.
I absolutely do not recommend this place, and I repeat, this is a Border Collie who has been in kennels since he was a puppy and is very used to it. DO NOT BRING HIM HERE

I'm leaving Lagun completely at ease; I know they'll take great care of him.
The meadow and facilities are fantastic.
Lovely girl, thank you so much....bone

I've left him with them for weekends as well as 10-day periods during vacations, and he always arrives very well cared for. He's happy when we arrive and greets everyone, which is a sign that he enjoys his time with them. Our furry friend is a bit antisocial, and with them, we've seen an improvement in his socialization (although if there's a gap between stays, he reverts to his old habits). I have a lot of confidence in them because it's clear they know the animals and can read them. They have climate control in the dogs' resting area and have routines for socialization based on size, so the larger, more energetic dogs are separated from the smaller ones that might get nervous (like mine).
Thank you so much for the review. Duna is now part of our family 💕🐶. We hope to see you soon! …
A 5-star hotel for your dog...it has everything, with lots of attention, love, and dedication. Thank you so much for taking such good care of my Malinois, Hera!

They're the best! We've left our Frenchie there a couple of times now while on vacation, especially in the summer when we're always a little nervous about bulldogs in the heat... and everything's been great! The facilities are excellent, climate-controlled, he has a fantastic time, and they're incredibly affectionate with him! Baco's trusted kennel 😀
Highly recommended place to leave your dog in good hands if you're going on a trip or need them for any other reason. They know dogs, and it's clean and safe.

You're the best!!! Vero, we'll miss you, we hope to see you again soon, thank you so much for everything!! Thanks to Melania and Silvia for your dedication and empathy. Especially, a thousand thanks to Sonia for so much love, for always taking such special care of Oreo, you're wonderful!! Our dogs are happy there and they adore you!! You've become family. How lucky we are to have met you!!
Thank you for your feedback.
Thank you for your feedback.

I've trusted this dog boarding kennel since our Labrador, Yuki, was a puppy, and after years of experience, I can say I wouldn't change it for anything. The level of professionalism and care they show the animals is exceptional.

The facilities are always spotless and perfectly equipped. The spaces are spacious and designed so the dogs can play, socialize, and rest comfortably.

The team is not only highly professional but also conveys a genuine love for animals. They maintain open and transparent communication with me, sending me updates on how Yuki is doing during her stay whenever we ask.

The ultimate proof is every time I pick Yuki up: she's always relaxed, happy, and eager to play. It's clear she's enjoyed her time there and received the love and care she deserves.

I wholeheartedly recommend this kennel to any owner looking for a completely trustworthy place for their furry companion. The value for money is unbeatable, but above all, the peace of mind of knowing Yuki is in the best hands is priceless.
Thank you very much, Luis.

I just wanted to say that if you're looking for a place that will take good care of your pet and truly care for them, this is the place. They treated us exceptionally well. My dog ​​is a potentially dangerous breed (PPP), and many places would reject you just for knowing that, but not here. They get to know you, see your dog without hesitation, and give him a personalized check-up. You can tell they love animals. Thank you all.

First of all, I want to thank Silvia, Sonia, and Vero for their fantastic work. They were lovely, and especially thank you for your patience with Ares, who is a terrestrial dog. You kept me informed about how he was doing and sent me photos and videos of how much fun he had. The place is spectacular, always clean, and they are super attentive to all your dog's needs. I'm delighted with the service; Ares can't wait to come back. He had a blast. Thank you, ladies!

Dear Sawed, We are sorry to hear about your dissatisfaction. We don't know which pet may have come to our facilities. However, if you contact our staff, we will look into the reason for your feedback, as we are unaware of your situation.
Sincerely,

About 10 years ago, I had to leave my two dogs, Tana and Xena, for about a month due to a family matter, and they were treated wonderfully. When I returned, they were doing great, so I'm so grateful ❤️❤️❤️❤️
Good dog center
Great professionals and magnificent facilities in a spacious natural setting, personalized attention for each animal, and excellent care. Happy dogs! 100% recommended

Thanks, Santiago!


Thanks!
Thanks Rafael!

Dear Juan,
We regret that we did not meet your expectations. If you contact us, we can learn more about your case, as we are unaware of the reasons for your rating.
We've spent two weekends there and the experience has been incredibly positive. The instructor is a delight to work with. Highly recommended, we'll definitely be back for the next course.

Thor isn't the easiest dog to handle, but at the Gufy center they treated him wonderfully and he left super happy!

Thank you!!
They hate dogs in this place.

Our veterinarian recommended this place 7 years ago and we have left Kibo, Cala and Lucha at this place. They are always calm and happy when we drop them off. We just left them for the 6th time and they returned today so unbelievably happy and fine. Thanks so much for caring so well for our dogs. Just one suggestion-please try to send photos or videos even if the clients don’t ask because it’s just nice to know they are okay. If I had these photos I would have posted them. Thanks!
Thanks Mary

Thanks Luca,
We will continue working hard to offer the best services.

After taking my dog ​​Zeppelin there several times, I have to say that I'm quite satisfied with the care they provide. However, on this last visit, after four days, when it came time to pay, they charged me an extra €18 for picking up the …

We left our 11-year-old Yorkshire Terrier, Rocky, for the first time, and he was thrilled, as were we. We were in the US and kept in touch with the boarding facility via WhatsApp without any problems. Without a doubt, he'll return to Gufy when we need him.

In September we had an international trip planned, so we needed to leave Reis with someone. We trusted Gufy again five years after the last time we left him, as he has traveled with us every chance he got, and we couldn't be happier. Reis …
Thank you Jesus, we will continue working to offer the best service.
